name: Cellar Wall Torch v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Owner-standard concept vs editable custom-topology Blender source
review_note: The Blender asset preserves the concept's long crooked shaft, broad soot cup, wrapped pitch head, irregular four-rivet backplate, fitted bent bracket, large three-layer faceted flame, warm low-poly planes, and clear wall-mounted construction. Its custom wireframe and deliberate face-color ramps avoid the rejected primitive-assembly look.
improve: Keep the runtime glow restrained so the ember, orange, and gold flame layers remain visible; do not scale the fixture above the approved player-relative size.
